# netskope_device_classification_tag (Resource)

Manages a device classification tag (label). Tags are used to classify devices based on posture and can be referenced in NPA policy rules via the `device_classification_id` field.

Tags are created in the Netskope UI under **Settings > Device Classification**, or via this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_device_classification_tag" "managed" {
  name        = "Managed Devices"
  description = "Devices with endpoint protection installed"
}
```

### Use in an NPA Rule

```terraform
resource "netskope_device_classification_tag" "edr_installed" {
  name        = "EDR Installed"
  description = "Devices with CrowdStrike or SentinelOne"
}

resource "netskope_npa_rules" "edr_required" {
  rule_name = "require-edr"
  enabled   = "1"
  group_id  = netskope_npa_policy_groups.default.id

  rule_data = {
    policy_type = "private-app"

    match_criteria_action = {
      action_name = "allow"
    }

    private_apps  = [netskope_npa_private_app.secure_app.private_app_name]
    access_method = ["Client"]

    device_classification_id = [tostring(netskope_device_classification_tag.edr_installed.tag_id)]
  }
}
```

## Import

Import by tag ID:

```shell
terraform import netskope_device_classification_tag.example 12345
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name (max 80 characters, alphanumeric, hyphens, spaces)

### Optional

- `description` (String) Tag description

### Read-Only

- `tag_id` (Number) Tag ID (used in `device_classification_id` on NPA rules)
- `priority` (Number) Tag priority (lower values = higher priority)
- `policy_names` (List of String) Policy names associated with this tag
